content.short: Heist On Alpha is a high-octane, action-packed multiverse experience across multiple platforms that reinvents the heist genre for a new generation.
content.description: Heist On Alpha is a high-octane, action-packed multiverse experience that reinvents the heist genre for a new generation . The Heist On Alpha Graphic Novel (Part 1) is available digitally as part of a multi-asset NFT on Cardano (includes a PFP + theme music), and also physically as a limited print edition 74 page book. An Extended Special Edition is available on Book.io and features the graphic novel , two spin-off short comics , and over 60 pages of extras.
